statements.claim: For a finite coordinate domain, H(r) <= s if and only if L(s) <= r.
assumptions: Costs and residuals are exact non-negative integers.
The domain is an explicit finite list.
The minimum of an empty feasible set is positive infinity.
statements.scope: Finite exact integers only; None in Python and none in Lean denote positive infinity.

statements.claim: Increasing the charged-cost budget cannot worsen the finite structure value.
assumptions: The coordinate domain and target-indexed residual function are fixed.
The larger budget is at least the smaller budget.
statements.scope: Finite exhaustive budget grid through the greatest declared cost plus one.

statements.claim: Relaxing the residual threshold cannot increase the least charged cost.
assumptions: The coordinate domain and charged-cost function are fixed.
The larger residual threshold is at least the smaller threshold.
statements.scope: Finite exhaustive residual grid through the greatest declared residual plus one.

statements.claim: The direct two-part minimum equals the minimum of budget plus the exact structure value over declared finite cost levels.
assumptions: Every charged cost is an exact non-negative integer.
The budget set contains every charged-cost level declared by the finite domain.
statements.scope: The finite declared cost levels encode min_r(r + H(r)); this is not an unbounded or continuous optimization claim.

statements.claim: The structure curve of a finite archive subset is an upper bound on the full-domain structure curve.
assumptions: Every archive coordinate is an unchanged member of the declared full domain.
Cost and residual functions are identical on archive and domain members.
statements.scope: Subset upper bound only; no claim that a finite archive has found the full-domain optimum.

statements.claim: Appending unchanged coordinates to an archive cannot worsen its exact structure curve.
assumptions: The later archive begins with the complete earlier archive in the same order.
All appended coordinates belong to the same declared system.
statements.scope: Append-only finite archives; replacement or mutation of prior records is excluded.

statements.claim: Passing a larger conjunctive verifier suite implies passing each declared subset suite.
assumptions: Suite acceptance is conjunction over named checks.
Every check in the smaller suite occurs in the larger suite.
statements.scope: One-way subset implication only; the converse is intentionally not claimed.

statements.claim: Every emitted Pareto representative is an unchanged source member with a nondominated complete objective vector.
assumptions: All compared objective vectors are complete and have the same declared dimensions.
Strict dominance means componentwise no worse and strictly better in at least one component.
statements.scope: Lean proves source membership and nondominance; Python additionally checks byte-reconstructed artifact record identity.

statements.claim: Every nondominated objective vector has exactly its deterministic first-source representative in the finite Pareto output.
assumptions: The source order is fixed.
Duplicate objective vectors are represented by their first source occurrence.
statements.scope: Objective-vector completeness with deterministic duplicate representation, not semantic diversity.

statements.claim: A target-independent compiler transfers each source witness to cost budget r+a and residual bound s+b.
assumptions: One coordinate-only mapping is reused for every declared target.
Every source coordinate maps into the declared destination domain.
The compiler satisfies its declared additive cost overhead and targetwise residual slack.
statements.scope: Finite declared systems and additive bounds only; no tokenizer or natural-language preservation claim.

statements.claim: Compiler witness transfer induces the corresponding finite structure-curve and threshold-curve directional bounds.
assumptions: All FC-01 compiler obligations hold.
The source and destination use the same ordered target set.
statements.scope: Directional finite bounds with explicit additive overhead and slack; no reverse inequality is implied.

statements.claim: Composition of two target-independent compilers adds their declared cost overheads and residual slacks.
assumptions: The first compiler destination is the second compiler source.
Both compilers satisfy complete coverage and bound obligations.
statements.scope: Finite coordinate mappings with additive bounds; compiler content digests bind the endpoints.

statements.claim: Directional compiler bounds hold generally, and opposite zero-residual-slack compilers give a threshold sandwich up to their separate cost overheads.
assumptions: Both directional compiler mappings satisfy complete finite obligations.
The threshold sandwich additionally requires zero residual slack in both directions.
statements.scope: The zero-slack sandwich is not asserted for positive residual slack; each direction retains its own cost overhead.
